round: the candidates proposed by the Scopus screening of 2026-10-07
frame: the 30 include candidates in the direct, requirements and instrument layers. The method layer was not tried: a method paper offers a way to measure a property rather than a property, so it cannot change the list of criteria.
routes: the same open routes the review has always used, in this order: a direct URL if the record has one, Europe PMC open-access full text, then every Unpaywall location. A second pass walked all locations with browser headers; a third tried the publisher's own open-access URL pattern for the five that matter most. A fourth pass asked CORE, with a key the investigator authorised from a sibling project; it answered for two records the publishers had refused, holding the extracted text rather than the PDF.
retrieved_is_not_read: Seven files are the article. Six were read in full on 2026-10-07 and are sources S22 to S27 of the catalog, with every quote checked against the file it came from. One, the SOAP completeness paper, was read and yielded no property worth taking, which is recorded on the row rather than left to look like an oversight.

what_this_blocks: Three of the five papers most likely to carry a property the catalog does not have are in that list: the Psychotherapie study of ambient AI scribes in psychotherapy documentation, the mixed-methods study of therapists writing notes together with their clients, and the forensic outpatient service's restructured documentation template. They are open access and need a browser the publishers will answer. Until they are read, no candidate is added and none is ruled out.
not_in_the_ledger: These are screened candidates, not reports the review has used. reports.json covers the reports a catalog source rests on; a candidate enters it when a property is extracted from it. Recording the attempt here keeps the dated fact without claiming the candidate is a source.

corrections.what: Three of the ten files counted as retrieved were not the article. Two publishers and one repository answered with their own page, which the fetch accepted because it was large enough to look like an article; reading them found 438, 580 and 401 words of menus and furniture.
corrections.effect: seven retrievals, not ten, and the three are back among the not retrieved with the reason. The size test that let them through is recorded here rather than quietly tightened: a fetch cannot tell an article from a page about an article by length alone, and only reading the file decides.
